task.title: Create a Site in AuditX
task.shortdesc: A site represents a physical location (warehouse, fulfillment center, or distribution point) where AuditX devices are deployed. Create a site to specify your operational location details in the AuditX system.

ul.li: You must have Admin or Custom User role
You must be logged into the AuditX Forge portal
Your password has been successfully reset
You have information about your physical location (site name, type, address)

context.p: Site creation is the first step in system initialization. Each site represents a distinct operational location and helps organize devices, users, event data, and reports by physical warehouse or fulfillment area.
context.note: Organizations with multiple warehouses should create separate sites for each location to maintain clear operational segregation.

step.cmd: Open the AuditX Forge portal in your web browser
step.info: Navigate to the Forge login page and log in with your credentials.

step.cmd: Locate the "Site" tab in the left-hand navigation menu
step.info: The Site menu is typically found in the main navigation panel on the left side of the dashboard.

step.cmd: Click the "Add Site" button on the right side of the screen
step.info: A site creation form will appear on the screen.

step.cmd: Enter the site name in the "Site Name" field

substep.cmd: Use a descriptive name that identifies the location

step.cmd: Select the "Site Type" from the dropdown menu

ul.li: Select the category that best represents your operational location
Common site types include: Warehouse, Fulfillment Center, Distribution Hub, Return Center

step.cmd: Fill in additional site details as required by the form

substep.cmd: Enter physical location information (address, city, state, postal code)

step.cmd: Review all entered information for accuracy
step.info: Double-check the site name, type, and location details before proceeding.

step.cmd: Click the "Save" button at the bottom of the form
step.info: The system will validate your entries and create the site.

result.p: Your site has been successfully created in the AuditX system. The site now appears in your Sites list and is available for assignment to hardware devices.

ul.li: Next step: Assign the site to an AuditX device (Assign Site to a System)
Create user accounts with appropriate access levels for this site
Assign users to the site for operational access
